name: (ADFS) Image Optimizer
description: Automatically compresses and optionally converts images to WebP on file save. Tracks per-file savings. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.
project_description: (ADFS) Image Optimizer is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that compresses images on file save using the PHP GD extension. When enabled, hook_file_presave runs the ImageOptimizerService on newly saved files whose MIME type matches the configured rules: it optionally downscales to a maximum width/height, re-encodes at the configured JPEG quality or PNG compression level, and can write a .webp copy alongside the original. It re-encodes into a temp buffer first and (when skip_if_larger is on) keeps the original if the result is not smaller, skips animated GIFs, and tracks cumulative bytes saved in Drupal State plus a per-file record in the adfs_image_optimizer_log table. A settings form, a bulk-optimize batch form and a log page live under admin/config/media/advanced_filesystem/image-optimizer, and two Drush commands (adfs:image-optimizer:run and :stats) bulk-optimize existing files and report savings. It performs all work locally through GD with no external service. Administration is gated behind a single restricted permission.
